summary: Verified the StepUpModal Radix Dialog fix. Created a new merchant via '新增账户' which triggered the 428 step_up flow; the stepup-opcode input accepted typed text ('123456'), supported clear+retype, submission succeeded, the step-up modal closed, the create-account dialog closed, and the new merchant appeared in the accounts table with a '账户已创建' toast. Also verified the SECONDARY path: on an existing merchant row, '余额调整' with amount 1 triggered the same step-up modal; opcode input was typable, submit succeeded and modal closed. Core regression (input not typable because StepUpModal rendered outside the underlying Radix dialog) is RESOLVED.

critical_code_review_comments: StepUpModal correctly uses the project's Radix Dialog primitives; z-[90] class on DialogContent is a safe additional stacking hint. Portal from the ui/dialog ensures it mounts above the underlying create/adjust dialog, which is what fixes the pointer-events/focus trap.
lib/api.js axios interceptor pattern (requestStepUp -> retry with X-Op-Code/X-Op-Totp headers) works as designed; the 428 response is observed and transparent to the triggering page.
Consider surfacing a user-facing error (opts.error) when the retried request still fails (currently resolver.reject only logs 'cancelled').

context_for_next_testing_agent: The step-up (StepUpModal) is now a Radix Dialog using @/components/ui/dialog. data-testid: stepup-modal, stepup-opcode, stepup-totp, stepup-submit, stepup-error. The admin requires op-code '123456' (no TOTP) when the backend returns 428 step_up. Accounts page is reached via nav-accounts-link (not by directly visiting /accounts after a hard reload — the SPA renders from /).
rca of the issue: Prior StepUpModal rendered as a custom overlay outside the open Radix Dialog, so Radix's modal (which sets pointer-events:none on siblings and traps focus) prevented the step-up inputs from receiving focus/keystrokes. Fix: StepUpModal was converted to a Radix Dialog using the shared ui/dialog primitives, which mounts via DialogPortal above all other overlays and manages focus correctly, so its inputs are focusable and typable even when another Radix Dialog is open underneath.
